newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian OTC market firms in week to Aug 1.
newsitem.headline: Croatian OTC market firms in week to Aug 1.

text.p: Croatian over-the-counter market firmed in the week to Aug 1 on the back of a bourse rally, the Varazdin Securities Market reported on Monday.
It put the weekly volume at 28,977 compared to 19,801 units, with turnover rising to 11.1 from 7.2 million kuna.
The leading seven-stock VIN index added 38 points or 0.39 percent on a weekly basis to 9,798 points as 14 traded issues rose and 12 fell.
Gainers were led by Ericsson Tesla, Croatian subsidiary of Sweden's telephone giant, rising 26.09 percent to 580 kuna. It dominated trade with 7,959 shares sold, representing 58 percent of all deals.
Ericsson Tesla jumped 58.14 percent through July and had a total monthly OTC market share of 65 percent.
Podravska Banka with two second issue shares sold was the biggest decliner, losing 18.8 percent to 203 kuna.
It was followed by Brodospas shipyard, which fell 9.09 percent to 100 kuna on volume of 201 shares.
